name: Indiginus The Mandolin
help: Indiginus. In Kontakt: SOLO mode; DISABLE CHORDS KEY SW on (default); Exp CC11 amount up (the default looks low); velocity grid Low = Mutes, High = off; Master Key = the song's key. Articulation keys are momentary (confirmed by the D0 test, 2026-10-07): the driver holds a key for the ornamented note only. Narrow "range" to the keys Kontakt colours as playable. Slots mode only: CHORDS mode and chord keyswitches enabled.
